payload.subject: Three orphaned suites caught real defects
payload.name: Three orphaned suites caught real defects
payload.goal:
Three test suites fail on main today, and nothing runs them: 149 of the 242 files in tests/ have no
test:<name> script and are not members of data/tasks/test:all.task.json, so `npm run govern` never
executes them. That is why these three rotted into failure unnoticed. They are not stale tests. Each
one caught a real defect, all three in the same family: components disagree about where the event log
is and which layout is authoritative. Expedition 2c9c6c62 (commit cbd8b4d) added the single authority
- locateEventLog in src/infra/event-store.ts - and fixed the three operator-facing symptoms. These are
the remaining places that still guess.

DEFECT 1 - the default bootstrap path never discovers a legacy-only event log.
`expedition approve --dry-run` in a pre-chunking project reports stateDelta "expedition e1 status:
unknown -> approved" instead of "draft -> approved"; 4 assertions in tests/lifecycle-dry-run.test.js
fail. The fixture is a legitimate pre-chunking project: it seeds only .synth/data/event-log.jsonl.
createInfra (src/infra/index.ts:49-63) resolves the store from config.streamDir, else
dirname(config.eventLogPath)/event-stream, else eventsDir(cwd) - and the default bootstrap
(bootstrapWithCapabilities, src/cli/synth.ts:268; src/core/bootstrap.ts) passes none of those, so a
project whose only log is the legacy file rebuilds empty state. Product impact: every project created
before the log was chunked looks empty to lifecycle commands - statuses read "unknown", dry-run
previews misreport the transition they are about to make, and any gate that consults state sees a
blank ledger. locateEventLog already answers this question correctly; the default path must ask it.

DEFECT 2 - the documented default capability verifier is not part of the public surface.
tests/first-contact-verify.test.js dies at import: "The requested module
'../dist/first-contact/verify/index.js' does not provide an export named
'RuleBasedCapabilityVerifier'". The class exists (src/first-contact/verify/adapters/rule-based-verifier.ts:163)
and is instantiated internally (engine.ts:14), and docs/reference/genesis-verification-contract.md:17
documents it as the default CapabilityVerifier adapter - but the barrel re-exports only ./types.js and
./engine.js. A contract that is documented and consumed by tests is not optional surface; either the
barrel exports it or the document is wrong.

DEFECT 3 - materialize() reports an event-log path that does not exist.
materialize (src/first-contact/materialize/engine.ts:215-240) writes its 4 events into the chunked
store (<data>/event-stream/partition-{1,2,3}/segment-*.jsonl) and returns
eventLogPath = sdk.paths.eventLogFile(root) = <data>/event-log.jsonl, which it never creates. Measured
on a freshly materialized project: that path is absent, and a consumer trusting the return value
(tests/first-contact-replay.test.js) builds an EventStore over it and gets eventCount 0, chainValid
true (an empty chain is trivially valid), consistent false, with 5 divergences - stateHash (live
1546582784 vs replayed 1225963432) and missions.mission-…, expeditions.expedition-… twice, and
discoveries.artifact-… all undefined on the replayed side. The suite's own assertion eventCount === 4
can never hold through the returned path. Product impact: first-contact materialization hands every
caller a pointer to a log that is not there, so anything that verifies, audits or replays a brand-new
project through it reports a healthy new project as divergent and corrupt.

DEFECT 4 (latent, same family) - createFromFile builds a store over a temp directory.
PartitionedEventStore.createFromFile (src/infra/event-store.ts:571-586) reads a legacy file and appends
its events into os.tmpdir()/synth-log-<ts>-<rand>/event-stream, returning that store. Appends to it are
therefore silently discarded. All four current callers pass readOnly: true (explain-observability:113,
explain-replay-light:52, explain-paths:57 via --log, synth.ts:8414), so it is contained today - but
nothing enforces that, and the first write path to pass eventLogFile would lose events without an
error. This needs a guard, not a rewrite.

NON-GOALS - do not widen into these.
* Do not consolidate or re-wire the other 146 orphaned suites. That is EXP-TEST-002 "Merge suites
  114->~70" (approved, f6420030064a6f70, untouched). This expedition adds a test:<name> script and
  test:all membership for exactly these three suites, so the fixes stay fixed; the remaining 146 and
  the standalone-marking guard belong to EXP-TEST-002.
* Do not weaken, skip or delete a failing assertion to get green. A fixture change is acceptable only
  where the fixture is itself the lie; in Defect 1 the legacy-only fixture is a real pre-chunking
  project, so the code must adapt, not the test.
* Do not rewrite the replay verifier or its divergence model. Defect 3's five divergences are a correct
  report of an empty read.
* Do not remove or migrate away the legacy layout. Expedition 2c9c6c62 pinned that it must keep
  reading; a pre-chunking project is a supported input, not an error.

ACCEPTANCE
* node --test tests/lifecycle-dry-run.test.js: 4/4 pass, and stateDelta reads "draft -> approved" for a
  project whose only log is the legacy file.
* node --test tests/first-contact-verify.test.js: the suite imports and passes, with
  RuleBasedCapabilityVerifier reachable from the barrel exactly as the reference doc describes.
* node --test tests/first-contact-replay.test.js: eventCount === 4, consistent === true, zero
  divergences - read from the location materialize actually reports.
* All three runnable as npm run test:<name> and members of test:all, so `npm run govern` executes them.
* A guard proving a createFromFile-built store cannot silently discard an append.
* No regression in what expedition 2c9c6c62 touched: verify-engine 10/10, event-log-query 10/10,
  replay, replay-graph-integrity, graph-integrity, explain-observability, installer-verify,
  first-operator-experience, synth-cli all still pass.
* `synth verify` ok and `synth checkpoint` truthful on this repository afterwards.
